_comment: Copy to settings.json and edit. Every field is optional.
brandVoice: Optional. A sentence or two describing how your captions should sound, e.g. 'Blunt and practical. No hype. Short sentences.' Appended to the caption system prompt.
exportDir: Optional. Where exported carousels are written. Defaults to ./exports. Supports ~ for your home directory.
likenessPath: Optional. Absolute path to a photo of you, used as a reference image when 'Use my likeness' is checked.
likenessDescription: Optional. Appended to the image prompt so the model gets your appearance right, e.g. 'The person in the image is a young adult male. Always generate a male person, not female.'
communityUrl: Optional. Community or link-in-bio URL shown on flash-video footers, e.g. 'skool.com/your-community'. Left blank, the line is omitted.
